ai_usage_count_check.name: ai_usage_count_check
ai_usage_count_check.value: ("ai_usage_logs"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "ai_usage_logs"."input_tokens">=0) AND ("ai_usage_logs"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "ai_usage_logs"."output_tokens">=0) AND "ai_usage_logs"."duration_ms">=0

cases_required_check.name: cases_required_check
cases_required_check.value: length(trim("cases"."case_no")) > 0 AND length(trim("cases"."code")) > 0 AND length(trim("cases"."customer_name")) > 0 AND length(trim("cases"."address")) > 0

collector_finance_rate_check.name: collector_finance_rate_check
collector_finance_rate_check.value: "collector_finance_settings"."rate" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "collector_finance_settings"."kind" IN ('return','commission') AND (("collector_finance_settings"."active"=1 AND "collector_finance_settings"."effective_to" IS NULL) OR ("collector_finance_settings"."active"=0 AND "collector_finance_settings"."effective_to" IS NOT NULL))

installment_amount_check.name: installment_amount_check
installment_amount_check.value: "installment_plans"."total_amount">0 AND "installment_plans"."total_amount"<=1000000000000 AND ("installment_plans"."per_payment_amount" IS NULL OR ("installment_plans"."per_payment_amount">0 AND "installment_plans"."per_payment_amount"<="installment_plans"."total_amount"))

installment_type_check.name: installment_type_check
installment_type_check.value: ("installment_plans"."plan_type"='deadline' AND "installment_plans"."deadline_date" IS NOT NULL AND "installment_plans"."per_payment_amount" IS NULL AND "installment_plans"."weekday" IS NULL AND "installment_plans"."day_of_month" IS NULL) OR ("installment_plans"."plan_type"='weekly' AND "installment_plans"."weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND "installment_plans"."per_payment_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "installment_plans"."day_of_month" IS NULL AND "installment_plans"."deadline_date" IS NULL) OR ("installment_plans"."plan_type"='monthly' AND "installment_plans"."day_of_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND "installment_plans"."per_payment_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "installment_plans"."weekday" IS NULL AND "installment_plans"."deadline_date" IS NULL)

intake_terminal_check.name: intake_terminal_check
intake_terminal_check.value: "intake_items"."status" NOT IN ('matched','created') OR ("intake_items"."matched_case_id" IS NOT NULL AND "intake_items"."confirmed_data" IS NOT NULL AND "intake_items"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)

reports_payment_check.name: reports_payment_check
reports_payment_check.value: "reports"."payment_detected" IN (0,1) AND ("reports"."payment_amount" IS NULL OR ("reports"."payment_detected"=1 AND "reports"."payment_amount" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000))

reports_workflow_check.name: reports_workflow_check
reports_workflow_check.value: "reports"."workflow_status" IN ('awaiting_status','completed') AND ("reports"."workflow_status"<>'awaiting_status' OR ("reports"."source"='telegram' AND "reports"."callback_token" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."telegram_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."callback_route_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."assignment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."status"='needs_review' AND "reports"."completed_at" IS NULL))

review_items_resolution_check.name: review_items_resolution_check
review_items_resolution_check.value: ("review_items"."status"='pending' AND "review_items"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "review_items"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "review_items"."confirmed_data" IS NULL) OR ("review_items"."status"<>'pending' AND "review_items"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "review_items"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

settlement_return_check.name: settlement_return_check
settlement_return_check.value: ("settlements"."return_status"='pending' AND "settlements"."returned_at" IS NULL AND "settlements"."returned_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("settlements"."return_status"='returned' AND "settlements"."returned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "settlements"."returned_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
